newsitem.title: USA: WHX amends Dynamics tender offer.
newsitem.headline: WHX amends Dynamics tender offer.

text.p: WHX Corp said Wednesday that it amended its current tender offer for common stock of Dynamics Corp of America to be for any and all shares.
The expiration and withdrawal date of the tender offer is being extended until 1800 EDT/2200 GMT Tuesday, May 20.
WHX previously launched a hostile bid for up to 649,000 shares or about 17 percent of Dynamics' stock at $45 a share. WHX currently has a 2.9 percent holding in Dynamics.

The amended tender offer is subject to the invalidation or redemption of Dynamics Corp's "poison pill" rights plan and the appropriate waiver by Dynamics' board under the New York business combination statute. WHX did not elaborate.
WHX said the tender offer is not subject to financing.
As of Tuesday night, WHX said 1.53 million shares, or 40 percent of the total shares outstanding, had been tendered.
WHX also said it plans to solicit proxies at Dynamics' annual meeting, which has been rescheduled for August 1.
WHX said it plans to propose six nominees to the board, as well as several by-law amendments and a share resolution requesting the board remove the anti-takeover obstacles to WHX's offer.
Dynamics could not be immediately reached for comment.
WHX is the holding company for steelmaker Wheeling-Pittsburgh Integrated.
Dynamics makes consumer electrical housewares, electronic devices and industrial equipment.
